topics.titleTr: Çerezsiz Dünyada Dayanıklı E-posta Listesi Kurun
topics.titleEn: Build an Email List That Survives Cookieless
topics.angle: guide: grow owned first-party data as third-party tracking and search clicks shrink
topics.brief: Outline: why owned first-party data wins in 2026 (privacy rules, cookie decay, AI-overview click loss); lead magnets that still convert (tools, templates, cohort emails) vs tired PDFs; consent and double opt-in done right; progressive profiling instead of long forms; segmentation that lifts engagement; a welcome sequence that proves value fast; measuring list health (deliverability, open/click, churn) and pruning dead contacts. Verify: current third-party cookie status; email engagement benchmarks. Sources: ESP documentation; a recent email benchmark report.

topics.titleTr: Claude ile A/B Testi İçin Açılış Sayfası Varyantları
topics.titleEn: Draft Landing-Page Variants to A/B Test With Claude
topics.angle: how-to: use Claude to draft hypothesis-driven variant copy, then test it honestly
topics.brief: Outline: what to vary (headline, hook, CTA, proof, offer); prompting Claude for hypothesis-based variants instead of random ones; wiring variants into a test tool; sample size and significance basics; reading results without fooling yourself; when AI copy underperforms human copy. Verify: A/B significance math; minimum sample size. Sources: a CRO testing guide; a stats-significance reference.

topics.titleTr: Raporlarınızı Bozan UTM Hataları ve Çözümü
topics.titleEn: The UTM Naming Mistakes Wrecking Your Reports
topics.angle: mistakes: the naming errors that split your analytics, and the taxonomy that fixes them
topics.brief: Outline: how inconsistent UTMs silently fragment reports (Email vs email vs EMAIL become three sources); the five UTM params explained with when each matters; a lowercase, no-space, documented convention with controlled vocabularies for source/medium/campaign; a shared URL builder plus a spreadsheet registry; governance (who owns the rules, how new values get added); auto-lowercasing at ingestion; cleaning or remapping messy historical data without losing attribution. Verify: GA4 UTM handling and case sensitivity. Sources: GA4 documentation; a UTM builder tool's guide.

topics.titleTr: CI'da Claude Code Review ile PR Kapısı Kurun
topics.titleEn: Gate PRs With Claude Code Review in CI
topics.angle: how-to: wire claude ultrareview into GitHub Actions to review every PR automatically
topics.brief: Outline: what ultrareview does on a PR; the workspace-trust requirement and the --trust-workspace flag (PR number before the flag); a minimal GitHub Actions job; review levels (Quick/Standard/Deep) per repo; gating vs advisory comments; controlling cost and comment noise; stopping an always-on subscription. Verify: 2.1.309 workspace-trust syntax and review levels. Sources: code.claude.com changelog and CI docs.

topics.titleTr: Tekrarlanabilir Ortamlar: Dev Container ve Nix
topics.titleEn: Reproducible Dev Environments: Dev Containers vs Nix
topics.angle: comparison: two ways to make 'works on my machine' disappear
topics.brief: Outline: the 'works on my machine' problem and what a broken onboarding day actually costs; Dev Containers (devcontainer.json, Codespaces, local editor support, prebuilt images); the Nix/flakes approach (declarative, pinned, reproducible shells); trade-offs across learning curve, startup speed, team buy-in, and reuse in CI; how to combine them (Nix inside a dev container); the payoff of onboarding a new dev with one command; where each one hurts. Verify: devcontainer spec; nix flakes basics. Sources: containers.dev; nixos.org Nix flakes docs.

topics.titleTr: SLO ve Hata Bütçeleri: Uygulamalı Kurulum
topics.titleEn: SLOs and Error Budgets: A Practical Setup
topics.angle: guide: pick SLIs, set SLOs, and use error budgets to balance speed and reliability
topics.brief: Outline: SLI vs SLO vs SLA in plain terms; choosing SLIs that reflect user pain (availability, latency percentiles, freshness, correctness); setting realistic targets from real traffic instead of aspiration; defining the error budget and the math behind multi-window burn-rate alerts; writing the policy (slow or freeze releases when the budget is spent) and getting leadership to honor it; common mistakes (99.99% for everything, averaging latency instead of using percentiles, alerting on symptoms you can't act on). Verify: burn-rate alert math; Google SRE definitions. Sources: Google SRE Workbook (SLOs chapter).

topics.titleTr: Çok Bölgeli Postgres: Seçenekler ve Ödünleşimler
topics.titleEn: Multi-Region Postgres: Options and Trade-offs
topics.angle: deep-dive: read replicas, logical replication, and distributed Postgres compared
topics.brief: Outline: the three real reasons to go multi-region (latency for distant users, regional failover, data-residency law) and why none is 'scale'; read replicas plus request routing and the read-your-writes trap; logical replication for selective sync; distributed options (Citus, Neon, Spanner-style) and what they cost in complexity; the hard consistency vs latency trade-off; failover, split-brain, and promotion drills; residency rules that force where rows live. Close with the honest case for staying single-region until pain is proven. Verify: replication-lag behavior; distributed Postgres feature sets. Sources: PostgreSQL docs; two managed-Postgres vendor docs.

topics.titleTr: ChatGPT ile Hızlı ve Kazandıran Satış Teklifleri
topics.titleEn: Draft Winning Sales Proposals Fast With ChatGPT
topics.angle: how-to: a repeatable proposal workflow from discovery notes to a sendable document
topics.brief: Outline: capture discovery notes cleanly; a proposal template (problem, outcome, scope, price, proof, next step); prompt ChatGPT to draft from notes plus template; tailor tone to the buyer; present pricing with options; a pre-send review checklist; what you must never let AI invent (numbers, client facts). Verify: nothing fact-critical; flag client-data privacy. Sources: a B2B sales proposal playbook.

topics.titleTr: Yapay Zeka İçerik Etiketleme: KOBİ Uyum Listesi
topics.titleEn: AI Content Labeling: An SMB Compliance Checklist
topics.angle: checklist: what a small business must disclose and label under 2026 AI rules
topics.brief: Outline: who this hits (anyone running chatbots or publishing AI-generated media); EU AI Act Article 50 transparency duties and the 2 Dec 2026 GPAI content-labeling date; what 'label' means (chatbot disclosure, synthetic-media marking/metadata); practical steps (disclosure copy, watermarks, records); penalty exposure. Verify: Article 50 scope, the Dec 2 2026 date, penalty figures (up to EUR 35M or 7%). Sources: EUR-Lex AI Act; European Commission AI Act page.

topics.titleTr: Kurucu Tükenmişliği: Büyürken Ayakta Kalmak
topics.titleEn: Founder Burnout: Staying Sane While You Scale
topics.angle: guide: the patterns that burn founders out and the systems that prevent it
topics.brief: Outline: the always-on trap and the new 'agent slot-machine' loop that scrambles focus; decision fatigue; separating identity from the company; building rhythms (work windows, a real day off, delegating to AI agents without babysitting them); when AI cuts load vs adds it; founder support systems. Verify: cite burnout research qualitatively (contested productivity evidence). Sources: Axios AI-agent-burnout reporting; an HBR well-being summary.

topics.titleTr: React'te Komut Paleti (Cmd+K) Nasıl Yapılır?
topics.titleEn: Build a Command Palette (Cmd+K) in React
topics.angle: how-to: a keyboard-first command menu with search, groups, and actions
topics.brief: Outline: the UX of Cmd+K and why apps add it; using the cmdk library vs building on Radix Dialog; fuzzy search and grouping; async actions and routing; accessibility (focus trap, ARIA roles, screen-reader announcements); theming; keeping it fast with large command sets. Verify: cmdk API; the WAI-ARIA dialog/combobox pattern. Sources: cmdk docs; WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices.

topics.titleTr: React useOptimistic ile İyimser Arayüz
topics.titleEn: Optimistic UI With React's useOptimistic Hook
topics.angle: how-to: instant UI updates with graceful rollback when the server rejects them
topics.brief: Outline: what optimistic UI is and the latency it hides (likes, todos, comments); a worked example of useOptimistic paired with a Server Action; how the temporary optimistic state reconciles with the server result; rolling back and showing a clear error on failure; handling rapid repeated actions and out-of-order responses; where optimism is dangerous and you should wait (payments, irreversible writes, money balances); testing the failure path, not just the happy path. Verify: useOptimistic signature and Server Actions interplay. Sources: React documentation (useOptimistic, Server Actions).

topics.titleTr: TypeScript'te Tip Güvenli Ortam Değişkenleri
topics.titleEn: Type-Safe Env Vars and Config in TypeScript
topics.angle: guide: validate and type configuration so a bad env never reaches runtime
topics.brief: Outline: the stringly-typed env problem and the 3am outage a missing variable causes; defining a schema with Zod/valibot (or t3-env) and parsing process.env once; failing fast at boot with a readable error instead of undefined deep in a request; separating server-only secrets from client-exposed (NEXT_PUBLIC-style) vars so keys never ship to the browser; coercing and defaulting values; typing per-environment config; a committed .env.example; testing config loading. Verify: t3-env and Zod APIs; client/server env separation in frameworks. Sources: t3-env docs; Zod docs.

topics.titleTr: Instagram Deneme Reels: Paylaşmadan Hook Test Et
topics.titleEn: Instagram Trial Reels: Test Hooks Before You Post
topics.angle: how-to: validate hooks with non-followers using Trial Reels, then promote the winners
topics.brief: Outline: what Trial Reels are (shown to non-followers first); scheduling them (2026 update); what to test (hook, first frame, topic, format); which signals to read (watch time, sends, replays) and which to ignore; promoting winners to your followers; limits and common misreads. Verify: Trial Reels scheduling and which metrics surface. Sources: Instagram Creators/newsroom; treat vendor-blog stats as unverified.

topics.titleTr: Kaydedilen LinkedIn Belge Karuselleri Nasıl Yapılır
topics.titleEn: LinkedIn Document Carousels That Get Saved
topics.angle: how-to: design PDF/document carousels that earn saves and dwell time
topics.brief: Outline: why document carousels still pull reach (dwell time, saves); structure (hook slide, one idea per slide, a clear CTA); design specs and tools; going from outline to PDF fast; posting plus a first-comment strategy; measuring saves and dwell instead of likes. Verify: LinkedIn document-post specs; dwell-time claims (mostly vendor-sourced, flag as such). Sources: LinkedIn help; two creator playbooks.

topics.titleTr: 2026'da Substack Notes'ta Kitle Büyütmek
topics.titleEn: Grow an Audience on Substack Notes in 2026
topics.angle: guide: use Notes as a discovery engine that feeds your newsletter
topics.brief: Outline: how Notes differs from X and Threads (recommendation-driven reach, directly wired to subscriptions); the flywheel from a single Note to a free and then paid subscriber; what actually travels (restacks with a take, short insights, teasers, behind-the-scenes) vs link dumps the feed buries; a realistic posting cadence for a solo writer; engaging with other writers to earn restacks; converting readers to your newsletter without being spammy; mistakes (auto-cross-posting from X, no native hook, pitching paid too early). Verify: Notes recommendation and restack mechanics. Sources: Substack docs and company blog.

topics.titleTr: ChatGPT Kilitli Sohbetler: Hassas İşleri Gizleyin
topics.titleEn: ChatGPT Locked Chats: Keep Sensitive Work Private
topics.angle: how-to: lock, hide, and protect sensitive conversations with a PIN or device auth
topics.brief: Outline: what Locked Chats do (hidden from history, pins, and search; opened with a PIN or device auth); how to set them up; when to use them (client data, HR, legal, salary); their limits (not a substitute for enterprise DLP or a private workspace); pairing with work/personal account separation. Verify: Oct 2026 Locked Chats behavior and auth options. Sources: ChatGPT release notes and help center.

topics.titleTr: Claude, ChatGPT ve Gemini ile Dil Öğrenin
topics.titleEn: Learn a Language With Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini
topics.angle: comparison: voice practice, correction, and roleplay across the three assistants
topics.brief: Outline: set up a tutor persona and system prompt; use voice mode for speaking practice (pace, accent); correction plus spaced review; roleplay scenarios (ordering, interviews); how the three compare on voice naturalness, correction quality, and memory; limits (never trust grammar blindly); a simple weekly plan. Verify: each tool's voice-mode and memory features. Sources: Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini product docs.

topics.titleTr: Daha Net Düşünmek İçin Karar Günlüğü Tutun
topics.titleEn: Keep a Decision Log to Think More Clearly
topics.angle: guide: record decisions and reasoning to beat hindsight bias and repeat your wins
topics.brief: Outline: what a decision log is and why memory lies; the entry template (context, options, decision, expected outcome, confidence, review date); where to keep it (notes app, or ADRs in the repo); reviewing predictions against reality; using AI to summarize entries and surface patterns; personal vs team logs. Verify: ADR format; the decision-journal concept. Sources: ADR references; Kahneman on hindsight bias.

topics.titleTr: Gerçekten İşe Yarayan Yapılandırılmış Loglama
topics.titleEn: Structured Logging That's Actually Useful
topics.angle: guide: log JSON with context so you can actually query an incident at 3am
topics.brief: Outline: why plain string logs fail under pressure; structured/JSON logging and consistent fields; correlation IDs and trace context; log levels that mean something; what you must never log (PII, secrets, tokens); sampling noisy logs to control cost; connecting logs to traces and metrics. Verify: OpenTelemetry log correlation and context propagation. Sources: OpenTelemetry logs docs; the 12-factor logs principle.

topics.titleTr: Yumuşak ve Kalıcı Silme: Doğru Yaklaşım
topics.titleEn: Soft Deletes vs Hard Deletes: Getting It Right
topics.angle: deep-dive: when to soft-delete, the hidden costs, and how to do it safely
topics.brief: Outline: the appeal of soft deletes; their hidden costs (broken unique constraints, query noise, 'deleted' data still leaking); partial indexes and strict query hygiene; GDPR right-to-erasure vs keeping soft-deleted rows; archive tables plus scheduled hard-delete jobs; keeping an audit trail. Verify: partial unique index behavior; GDPR Article 17 erasure. Sources: PostgreSQL docs; GDPR Article 17.

topics.titleTr: Hatasız Saat Dilimi ve Zaman Damgası Yönetimi
topics.titleEn: Handle Time Zones and Timestamps Without Bugs
topics.angle: checklist: store, transmit, and display time correctly across zones
topics.brief: Outline: store UTC, and know instant vs wall-clock time; timestamptz vs timestamp in Postgres; ISO 8601 with offsets on the wire; DST pitfalls and recurring-event storage; the IANA tz database and why it keeps changing; displaying in the user's zone; testing (freeze time, test odd zones like Kathmandu). Verify: timestamptz semantics; DST edge cases. Sources: PostgreSQL date/time docs; IANA tz database.
